named_events.loss_description: The net loss impact of the HIM losses booked in the 2017 year of account is GBP 14.6m.
a further GBP 1.5m of net claims arose from the Mexico earthquake in September 2017.
the 2016 year of account also had exposure to the HIM losses, with net losses recorded of GBP 2.4m, as well as net losses of GBP 1.8m arising from the Peruvian floods in March 2017.

The external RITC premium attaching to the run-off years contributed to the run-off years result (run-off years loss of GBP 8.0m in the calendar year split).

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle, older underwriting years (2011-2015) show a net adverse re-estimation of approximately GBP 5.13m at 31 December 2017 (a strengthening of reserves). This deterioration is largely attributable to adverse development on older years driven by large loss development and natural catastrophe exposure; the syndicate also recorded significant 2017 catastrophe losses (Harvey/Irma/Maria) which impacted the open years. Run-off years were subject to an external RITC arrangement (transfer at bidder-determined premiums) and some closed-year movements included both small releases (e.g. Hurricane Matthew release on 2016) and additional run-off year losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (values printed in the report are in GBP '000). The report contains an RITC for run-off years which can distort development patterns; the triangle was used despite this and may therefore be affected by RITC distortions. No explicit single-sentence gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure was provided; a gross triangle was used as the primary source. Units in the triangle are thousands; all monetary outputs above are converted to millions.
